After months of interviewing different home remodelers, I chose Wise Design & Remodel because of Phil’s experience with making the most out of small spaces. The best part of working with Wise was the communication and the hands-on nature of Phil and his team to make sure the vision is being properly conveyed in the actual build. 

- Michael, 2024

High Quality

Phil and his team did an outstanding job on our basement remodel project. The exercise room, complete with custom sauna, is amazing!! Furthermore, the custom wet bar with a built in wine rack is spectacular! Phil's attention to detail and his honest opinion regarding value added options was much appreciated. Very high quality craftsmanship! We won't work with anyone else after this!

 - Matt, 2023

Patient and Collaborative Approach

We needed major updates to our space but wanted to honor the Craftsman charm (with a touch of Prairie School) in our beautiful old 1914 home. Phil's patient and collaborative approach paid off in the creation of a design plan that perfectly complements our home and creates new functionality, but without compromising the vintage aesthetics of the space.  

- Dominic, 2023

Outstanding Work!

Wise Design & Remodel recently redesigned and remodeled our kitchen and dining room, and I can't say enough about how great Phil and his team are. From the first phone call through construction and close-out, they were incredibly attentive. Phil’s expertise really shines through—he turned our inefficient, quirky kitchen into a spacious, functional, and beautifully updated space. The transformation has improved our entire home. This was our first major remodel, and Phil anticipated potential issues while keeping us informed throughout. The project stayed on budget and on schedule, and the management software made it easy to track everything. After this experience, I can’t imagine trusting anyone else for a remodel.

- Wes, 2021

Creative, Accountable, Efficient and Client-Oriented

We had an excellent experience with Wise Design. The project re-imagined our kitchen, creating a dramatic transformation of our main floor that also enhanced the functionality and style of our entryway, living room, and the transition to the lower level. Philip and team are creative, accountable, efficient, and client-oriented to design and build the best remodel for our space. The craftsmanship and attention to detail was excellent. We now have a unique kitchen and dining area that works within our original home footprint. The result is a refreshed, striking home that we can thrive in as a family.

-Michelle, 2023

Easy to Collaborate With

We worked with Wise in 2022 to remodel our kitchen and had a great experience. Phil and team were easy to collaborate with, responsive to our needs, and always clearly articulated changes and tradeoffs. They also handled unforeseen issues  due to the nature of working with an older home with grace and skill. We're grateful to have had them by our side throughout this process and there was always a high sense of trust. The end result is exactly what we envisioned and I almost don't want to recommend them since we have too many other projects ;)

Elisa, 2022

Wise Design & Remodel is a Design-build remodeling company serving the Twin Cities and neighboring areas. Our team of dedicated professionals are experienced and passionate about their work. We pride ourselves on remodels that both function well and look amazing, while working hard to make the process as smooth and fun as possible. We look forward to hearing from you about your project.

Design Team

Philip Hide

FOUNDER, GENERAL CONTRACTOR

Philip was born & raised in North London, England, where he started his own remodeling business before bringing his expertise to Minnesota. As many of the homes in London were built in the 1800's, Phil truly specializes in designing smart, creative solutions for old homes without compromising their charm and historicity. Phil met his wife, Julianne, in London where she was studying abroad. They were married in 2007 and continued to live in London for 9 years before moving their family back to Minneapolis in 2014, where he founded Wise Design shortly thereafter. They have 3 children and a German Shepherd dog named Bear. 

Jason Miskowiec

ARCHITECT

Jason has over 15 years of Residential Design experience and holds a Master's in Architecture from the Illinois Institute of Technology, in addition to a Bachelor's in Architecture from the U of M. Working, studying and traveling to destinations such New York, Paris, Chicago, and Oaxaca have all contributed to the inspiration for design he brings to his home and work in Minneapolis. Jason is an avid Viking's fan and loves to travel, where his passions for food, architecture and culture converge. He keeps his office and apartment filled with plants and books, and occasionally brings his beloved dog, Remy, to visit the showroom.

Kim Aaron-Lehman

DESIGNER, KITCHEN & BATH SPECIALIST

Kim has been buying and renovating South Minneapolis homes for over a decade leading up to formally studying Kitchen & Bath Design and joining the Wise Design team. Prior to that, she taught Spanish at the university-level for 11 years and has lived abroad in 4 different countries from Latin America to Europe & the Middle East. As an artist, Kim dabbles in photography, furniture refinishing, painting, and ceramics, and stays busy with part-time property management, having fixed up and rented out 4 homes and a "Skoolie" over the years.

Production Team

Tim Leirness

PROJECT MANAGER

Tim has been in the remodeling industry for nearly 20 years and possesses extensive knowledge of both interior and exterior remodeling. Tim enthusiastically manages our projects with a friendly, client-centered approach. His organizational and communication skills are the key to keeping our operations running smoothly and our clients informed of the daily updates during the construction process. Tim is a devoted husband and father of two. In his free time, he enjoys working out, playing golf, and watching baseball.

Jhony Perez

PROJECT MANAGER, SITE SUPERVISOR

Jhony helps lead the team and supervises the projects. He is a skilled craftsman with over 20 years of experience. His kind and cheerful attitude is appreciated by our clients, who love having him on their projects. Jhony helps train the next generation to be as attentive to detail and proud of their work as he is. A fun fact about Jhony is that his family owns a coffee farm, he generously shares fresh coffee beans with the Wise Design family. Jhony is devoted to his wife and 3 daughters and recently became a Grandpa. 

Derrald Peterson

CABINET SPECIALIST

Derrald has been in the cabinet industry for over 40 years and brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the company. Over the years he has honed his cabinet making skills and partnered with many of the top designers in the Twin Cities, completing hundreds of kitchens and custom cabinetry projects. Derrald lives in Minneapolis, is happily married, and has 3 grown sons. He enjoys the outdoors, boating, and photography in his free time.

Nicholas Skarphol

TILING SPECIALIST 

Nick brings his passion for remodeling and expertise as both a Tiler and finish carpenter to the Wise Design Team. He pays close attention to the details and truly loves what he does. Nick’s friendly and caring attitude is always appreciated by our clients. He lives with his Fiancé and loves traveling and outdoor adventures.

Jonathan Kilian

FRAMING & CARPENTRY

Jonathan has come to us from Montpelier Vermont. He has been in the trades for over five years, with experience in the framing and flooring industries. His hobbies are playing guitar, camping, hiking, fly fishing and going to the gym. Jonathan has a passion and enthusiasm for remodeling and construction. He is such a great asset for our team that we forgive him for being a Boston Celtics fan (Go Wolves!).

Chris Dimitrievski

DRYWALL & CARPENTRY

Chris recently moved to the Twin Cities to be closer to his wife's family. His hobbies include Martial Arts, Hiking and Fishing (and remodeling). He is an avid tool collector and when it comes to tools, Chris follows this Mantra:  Better to have it and not need it, than need it and not have it! Chris loves all aspects of remodeling and is a fast learner. We are fortunate to have Chris on the team.

Administrative Team

Sheryll Storry

BOOKKEEPER

Sheryll has been with Wise Design and Remodel since 2018. She spent most of her career in public service, first teaching high school French, then working at Hennepin County, and later the Minnesota Department of Human Services.  After retiring in 2015, she went back to school to become a trained bookkeeper with a focus on the construction trades. While she loves working with numbers, her real passion is helping companies succeed by providing the necessary business intelligence gained from financial analysis. Some fun facts about Sheryll are that she’s an avid gardener, a grandma of 3 teen boys, and a world traveler. 

Julianne Hide

SHOWROOM MANAGER, DESIGN CONSULTANT

Julianne shares Philip’s passion for transforming homes into beautiful and functional living spaces. She helps manage the showroom at Wise Design and assists with designing. Julianne graduated from St. Kate’s University in St. Paul and met Phil in London during a term abroad. They married and lived together in London for 9 years before moving back to Minneapolis and continuing to raise their 3 kids here. Apart from the business, Julianne enjoys music and theatre, yoga and traveling, but most of all loves spending time with her family.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Our Expertise in Kitchen Remodeling St Paul MN

When you choose Wise Design & Remodel, you’re partnering with a team that understands kitchens are more than workspaces—they are the heart of your home. As one of the leading Kitchen remodel company St Paul MN, we bring together architecture, design, and craftsmanship to create spaces that are both timeless and functional. 

Our design-build approach ensures your kitchen remodel is seamless from start to finish. We handle every detail in-house, from space planning and 3D renderings to custom cabinetry and final installation. Whether your project calls for preserving the character of a historic Craftsman kitchen or bringing modern efficiency to a contemporary home, our team delivers solutions tailored to your lifestyle. 

With years of experience in kitchen remodels St. Paul, we’ve built a reputation for exceptional craftsmanship, clear communication, and a process that makes even the most complex remodels feel straightforward. 

The Role of a Kitchen Designer St Paul

Every successful remodel starts with a thoughtful design. Working with an experienced kitchen designer in St. Paul, MN, ensures your new space is both elegant and practical. Our designers take the time to understand your needs and ask questions like:  

Do you host large gatherings or intimate family dinners? 

Do you need smart storage for a busy household? 

Are you looking for a better connection between your kitchen, dining, and living spaces?

From there, we create a design that flows beautifully while supporting the way you live. 

In our St. Paul showroom, you can see and touch cabinetry, countertops, hardware, and fixtures before making decisions. This hands-on process builds confidence and ensures every detail reflects your personal style. 

Because our designers work side by side with our builders and project managers, your vision stays consistent from concept to completion. 

Why Choose Wise Design for Your Kitchen Remodel In St Paul

A kitchen remodel is a significant investment, and choosing the right partner makes all the difference. At Wise Design & Remodel, we pride ourselves on offering more than just construction services—we deliver a complete design-build experience that brings clarity and creativity to every stage of your project. 

Our team works under one roof, which means your kitchen remodel benefits from seamless collaboration between designer, architect, and builder. From the first sketch to the final installation, your vision is carried through without the miscommunication or delays that often come with multiple contractors.  

We also bring a unique sensitivity to St. Paul homes, many of which carry the architectural character of past generations. Whether it’s preserving original woodwork or thoughtfully modernizing the layout, we know how to balance history with innovation. 

Clients often tell us how much they appreciate our transparency throughout the process. With access to our project management tools and frequent communication from our team, you’ll always know what to expect—and feel confident that every detail is handled with care. 

As one of the most trusted kitchen remodel company in St. Paul, MN, we’re committed to creating spaces that feel timeless, functional, and unmistakably yours. 

St Paul Kitchen Renovation Ideas & Inspiration 

Every home has its own personality, and every homeowner has a vision. That’s why we approach each remodel with fresh ideas, designed to balance historic charm with modern function. Here are a few of our favorite kitchen renovation ideas in Saint Paul: 

Hidden Pantries: Keep counters clear by concealing appliances, dry goods, and storage behind cabinetry or a discreet door. 

Statement Islands: Add seating, storage, and prep space with an island that becomes the focal point of your kitchen. 

Blending Old and New: Pair original millwork or flooring with modern lighting and appliances for a seamless mix of eras. 

Smart Storage: From pull-out spice racks to custom drawer organizers, clever storage makes daily life effortless. 

Light and Flow: Open up sightlines, bring in natural light, and connect the kitchen to surrounding living spaces.

Why Remodel Your St Paul Basement? 

Your home should support the way you live, and your basement is often the key to unlocking more space without changing your address. A well-designed basement remodel in St. Paul, supported by professional basement remodeling services, can dramatically expand your living area while increasing the value of your home.

Imagine a cozy media room for movie nights, a serene wellness retreat complete with sauna, or a comfortable guest suite for visiting family. From quiet home offices to entertaining-ready wet bars, a basement renovation gives you the flexibility to create the spaces you’ve always wanted. At Wise Design & Remodel, we specialize in thoughtful, high-end transformations that reflect your goals, enhance your home, and respect its architectural integrity. 

Smart, Stylish Basement Solutions St Paul

No two homes (or homeowners) are alike. That’s why we take a tailored approach to every basement remodel, creating spaces that are as beautiful as they are functional. Whether you're dreaming of a refined entertainment space or a restful guest retreat, we bring creativity and craftsmanship to every project.

In addition, the contractors they use are the same and it felt like one big team. The basement remodel added a lot more livable space to our smaller home, and the bathroom remodel provided a much-needed refresh from the prior old and dated look. We would definitely recommend Wise Design as Phil and Team will treat you fairly and with kindness.”

Matt, 2023

“Phil and his team did an outstanding job on our basement remodel project. The exercise room, complete with custom sauna, is amazing!! Furthermore, the custom wet bar with a built in wine rack is spectacular! Phil's attention to detail and his honest opinion regarding value added options was much appreciated. Very high quality craftsmanship! We won't work with anyone else after this!”

Design decisions can feel overwhelming, but they don’t have to. Our interactive St. Paul showroom is designed to make the process engaging and stress-free. Here, you can see, touch, and compare cabinetry, finishes, flooring, and fixtures all in one place. 

With expert guidance from our design team, you’ll gain clarity and confidence in your selections. Plus, our fully functioning kitchen features local craft taps, so you can enjoy a relaxed, inspiring space while you plan your remodel.

Creating Beautiful Living Spaces in St Paul

At Wise Design & Remodel, we create tailored living spaces that enhance how you live every day. With our tailored living spaces remodeling services and professional living room remodeling services in St. Paul, we help homeowners transform underused rooms or outdated layouts into inviting, functional areas that truly feel like home. 

Our living room remodeling projects focus on improving flow, comfort, and everyday functionality. Whether opening up a dining area or creating a flexible family space, our design-build team approaches every project with the same commitment to craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Each remodel is tailored to your home’s character and your family’s lifestyle, ensuring the finished space is both beautiful and enduring. 

Our Approach to Living Space Design

A successful remodel balances design with functionality. As your dedicated living space remodeler, We begin by learning how you use your home today and how you’d like it to serve you in the future. Do you need a welcoming area for entertaining? A cozy den for quiet evenings? A multipurpose space that adapts as your family grows? 

Through our living room interior design services, we help homeowners select finishes, lighting, and architectural details that maximize natural light and connect seamlessly to other rooms in the home. From flooring and built-ins to lighting and trim, every detail is chosen to elevate the overall design. The result is a space that looks timeless, works beautifully, and feels uniquely yours.

St Paul Living Spaces Renovation Ideas 

Every home has untapped potential, and often it’s the living spaces like bedrooms, dens, and living rooms that hold the greatest opportunity for transformation. At Wise Design & Remodel, we help clients reimagine these areas so they feel both functional and inspiring. Our living room renovation service is especially valuable for older homes that need thoughtful modernization while preserving character. We understand how to adapt historic homes, mid-century layouts, and modern builds to today’s lifestyles.

Some of the most impactful updates include: 

Opening floor plans to create better flow between living, dining, and kitchen areas 

Introducing natural light with strategically placed windows or expanded openings 

Updating fireplaces to serve as warm, inviting focal points 

Adding custom built-ins for storage that blends seamlessly into the architecture 

Designing flexible layouts that can adapt as your family’s needs change 

We also specialize in preserving character while modernizing, whether that means highlighting original woodwork or thoughtfully updating finishes to feel fresh but timeless. 

We look forward to hearing from you.

Every room in your home should reflect the way you live. If you’re ready to transform your living spaces into areas that are both beautiful and practical, our team is here to help.  

Connect with Wise Design & Remodel to begin your project or visit our St. Paul showroom for design inspiration. Together, we’ll create living spaces that feel timeless, personal, and built to last.

Whole Home & Multi-Room Remodeling in St. Paul
Reimagine Your Home with a Cohesive Design-Build Renovation

A whole-home or multi-room remodel allows you to improve several areas of your home through one coordinated renovation. Rather than updating one room at a time, many Twin Cities homeowners choose to renovate connected spaces together, creating a more cohesive design, improving functionality, and making the most of the home they already love.

Our Whole Home Remodel Portfolio
Montcalm Whole Home Remodel in St. Paul
South Lake Owasso Multi-Room Remodel
Why Choose a Whole Home Remodel St. Paul?

Your home should support the way you live today, not the way it functioned decades ago. 

Many homeowners begin by considering a kitchen renovation or bathroom remodel, only to realize that other areas of the home could benefit from thoughtful improvements as well. By approaching the project as a complete renovation instead of a series of individual updates, you can create a home that feels unified from room to room. 

Whether you're remodeling two rooms or transforming your entire home, Wise Design & Remodel works with you to develop a comprehensive plan that balances beautiful design with practical functionality. 

A whole-home or multi-room remodel can help you: 

Create a cohesive design throughout your home. 

Improve how your family uses each space. 

Update multiple outdated rooms during one renovation. 

Increase storage and organization. 

Modernize finishes while preserving your home's character. 

Avoid years of piecemeal remodeling projects. 

Stay in the neighborhood you already love.

Is a Whole Home Remodel Right for You?

A Whole Home Remodel St. Paul project isn't only for homes that need extensive renovations. 

Many homeowners choose a comprehensive remodel because several rooms no longer fit their lifestyle. Perhaps the kitchen feels disconnected from the living spaces, the bathrooms need updating, and the basement remains underused. 

A coordinated renovation allows every decision to support the overall vision of the home. 

A whole-home remodel may be a good fit if: 

Several rooms need updating. 

Your layout no longer works for your family. 

You want a more consistent design throughout the house. 

You're planning to stay in your home long term. 

You're considering moving but love your current neighborhood. 

Whole Home Remodeling vs. Multi-Room Remodeling

Homeowners often ask whether there's a difference between a whole-home remodel and a multi-room remodel. 

In reality, the terms are closely related. 

A Multi Room Remodel St. Paul project typically focuses on renovating two or more connected spaces, such as: 

Kitchen and dining room 

Kitchen and primary bathroom 

Main floor living spaces 

Basement and bathroom

Kitchen, mudroom, and laundry room 

A whole-home renovation often expands that vision to include additional living spaces throughout the house. 

Regardless of the scope, the goal remains the same: creating a home that feels cohesive, functional, and thoughtfully designed.

Looking Beyond the Investment 

One of the first questions homeowners ask is about cost. 

Every renovation is unique, so there's no one-size-fits-all answer. Instead of focusing solely on construction costs, it's helpful to consider the complete financial picture. 

Many homeowners throughout St. Paul and Minneapolis currently enjoy mortgage rates that are significantly lower than today's market. Selling your home may mean taking on a higher monthly payment, along with closing costs, moving expenses, and the possibility of purchasing another home that still requires updates. 

For homeowners who already love where they live, investing in a renovation often provides greater long-term value than starting over somewhere new. 

The right decision depends on your home, your goals, and how long you plan to stay. For many homeowners, a Whole House Renovation St. Paul MN project offers better long-term value than starting over in a new home.Many homeowners begin with a Kitchen Remodel St. Paul before expanding the project into adjoining spaces.

What's Included in a Whole House Remodel in St. Paul, MN?

Every project is different, but whole-home renovations commonly include: 

Complete kitchen remodeling 

Primary and guest bathroom renovations 

Basement finishing and remodeling 

Living room updates 

Mudroom and laundry renovations 

Home office design 

Built-in storage 

New flooring throughout the home 

Interior millwork and trim 

Lighting improvements 

Interior reconfiguration 

Custom cabinetry 

A Whole House Remodeling St. Paul MN project can include any combination of the updates below, tailored to your home and lifestyle. Many homeowners begin with a Kitchen Remodel St. Paulbefore expanding the project into adjoining spaces.

Others choose to incorporate St. Paul Bathroom Remodeling alongside their kitchen renovation to create a cohesive main level and primary suite.

Check out what 94 people have written and share your own experience.","brand":{"@type":"Brand","@id":"https://www.wisedesignremodel.com","name":"Wise Design & Remodel"},"aggregateRating":{"@type":"AggregateRating","worstRating":1,"bestRating":5,"ratingValue":5,"ratingCount":94},"review":[{"@type":"Review","datePublished":"2026-10-02T17:08:17+00:00","reviewBody":"We used Wise Design and Remodel to renovate our kitchen, and we are so happy that we did! They built an addition into our backyard to make the space bigger, built a beautiful powder room, removed an existing wall to open it up, moved the exterior entry point in the backyard, installed a stunning kitchen, and ended up doing a ton of other work on the rest of the house.  Our house was built in 1927, and so it required someone with expertise in older homes to navigate the compact layout and old mechanicals. Of the 5+ contractors we talked to, Phil was the only person who identified a tricky upstairs staircase landing that resulted in only one affordable option. If we had gone with any of the others it would have been really bad! Phil is an expert at providing viable options based on his extensive experience working on historic homes in the US and in England. He also guided me through the design process by opening my eyes to kitchen lighting. I kept trying to make minimal changes to the layout thinking it would save us money. He patiently worked through this with us and helped me realize that the sink should be moved to the back of the house to enjoy the view of our backyard. I am so grateful for his guidance. He also went above and beyond by redoing an existing doorway to be an arch and installing a beautiful arch in the addition to match the home's architecture.  Phil and his team are responsive and care about customer satisfaction. We first met Jason, who came to the house very quickly after we submitted the request for a bid. He takes project management seriously and uses his architecture degree to come up with great ideas.  We love all of our selections. Kim did an excellent job providing beautiful drawings throughout and she and Phil were patient and knowledgeable about possible options. We spent a lot of time choosing cabinet styles, paint colors, and hardware. We asked them to repaint the space twice to get the color right. What ended up working in the kitchen was the paint color used for the powder room trim, but only after it was diluted 1:1 with white. They also painted a ton of trim in the entire house and all of the radiators. For the radiators, instead of using the round metal trim pieces, Phil had Tyler make custom oak round trim pieces to match the hardwood. Tyler does most of the trim work and does an excellent job, including exterior trim around the new addition. Our marble backsplash was expertly installed by Nick and is truly beautiful; everything is perfect.  Tim and Jhony run the day-to-day at the job site. They are the nicest guys you will ever meet. They care about any concern and work hard to fix anything. They also coordinate the work and cleanup. I was impressed by the team's care in protecting the existing house and the new construction from damage. Everything was protected with cardboard or plastic at all times, and they cleaned up daily. Derrald is the best cabinet installer I’ve met and he’s such a nice guy.  We also asked Phil for a lot of change orders, which he happily agreed to. This included refinishing the hardwood floors throughout the house to match the new kitchen floors that were expertly tied into the existing hardwood. They also removed built-in shelving in our living room and replaced it with sheetrock and beautiful wall sconces controlled with a switch. They redid a lot of the crown molding on the main level to make everything match. They installed a new gas fireplace, built a beautiful built-in frame for our Frame TV above the fireplace, and then refinished the brick, wood, and tile around the fireplace. Our roof started to leak during the remodel because of its age, and Phil got it replaced for us too. We also asked him to replace all of the gutters on the house, which he was happy to do.  We will definitely use Wise again and recommend giving them a call if you need remodeling work done.","url":"https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Google&query_place_id=ChIJbWom-MYp9ocRaLwfTYP71y4","author":{"@type":"Person","name":"Michael Danielson"},"reviewRating":{"@type":"Rating","worstRating":1,"bestRating":5,"ratingValue":5},"publisher":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Trustindex","sameAs":"https://www.trustindex.io"},"inLanguage":"en"},{"@type":"Review","datePublished":"2026-08-25T22:22:04+00:00","reviewBody":"Phil, Jason, Kim, Tim, Johnny, Derrald, and really the whole team at WISE fully made our kitchen remodel dreams come true. Putting the fun in function.  
Honoring original design with craftsmanship, creating innovative ideas for contemporary spaces.  

From Tudors to Craftsmen and stylish modern spaces, we work with you to learn what you love about your home and how you would like it to function. Our team helps find creative solutions to maintain the original character of your home while revitalizing it to fit the way you live today.    

INTERACTIVE SHOWROOM
See products in our showroom

Our showroom is an interactive experience, allowing you to learn how different products will look, function and feel before installing them in your home.  You’ll be able to select cabinetry doors, finishes, hardware, windows, shades, flooring and more without having to drive all over town.  We are a dealer for several lines of products, and bring profound product knowledge directly to your project.

Stay a while and enjoy a sampling from our fully-functioning kitchen, equipped with beverages and taps from our neighborhood breweries.  

CLEAR & TIMELY COMMUNICATION
Staying up to date on your project progress is only a click away.

Our project management software allows you to keep up-to-date with what is happening on your project daily.  Know which contractors to expect to be on-site and if there’s a change in the schedule you will be updated.  

The client portal also gives you direct access to the contracts, plans, scope of work and financials, all in one hub!

ST. PAUL REMODELING TEAM
Architect, Design, Project Management & Craftsmen all in one firm.

Our small but talented team includes a General Contractor, Architect, Kitchenand Bathroom Designers, Project Managers, and Skilled Carpenters. With a full-service team on staff, along with our diligent and trusted trade partners, we are able to collaborate on your project from start to finish. We take pride in delivering an exceptional product with a client experience to match.  

We look forward to hearing from you.

Meet Your Team

Wise Design & Remodel is a Design-build remodeling company serving the Twin Cities and neighboring areas. Our team of dedicated professionals are experienced and passionate about their work. We pride ourselves on remodels that both function well and look amazing, while working hard to make the process as smooth and fun as possible. We look forward to hearing from you about your project.

Design Team

Philip Hide

FOUNDER, GENERAL CONTRACTOR

Philip was born & raised in North London, England, where he started his own remodeling business before bringing his expertise to Minnesota. As many of the homes in London were built in the 1800's, Phil truly specializes in designing smart, creative solutions for old homes without compromising their charm and historicity. Phil met his wife, Julianne, in London where she was studying abroad. They were married in 2007 and continued to live in London for 9 years before moving their family back to Minneapolis in 2014, where he founded Wise Design shortly thereafter. They have 3 children and a German Shepherd dog named Bear. 

Jason Miskowiec

ARCHITECT

Jason has over 15 years of Residential Design experience and holds a Master's in Architecture from the Illinois Institute of Technology, in addition to a Bachelor's in Architecture from the U of M. Working, studying and traveling to destinations such New York, Paris, Chicago, and Oaxaca have all contributed to the inspiration for design he brings to his home and work in Minneapolis. Jason is an avid Viking's fan and loves to travel, where his passions for food, architecture and culture converge. He keeps his office and apartment filled with plants and books, and occasionally brings his beloved dog, Remy, to visit the showroom.

Kim Aaron-Lehman

DESIGNER, KITCHEN & BATH SPECIALIST

Kim has been buying and renovating South Minneapolis homes for over a decade leading up to formally studying Kitchen & Bath Design and joining the Wise Design team. Prior to that, she taught Spanish at the university-level for 11 years and has lived abroad in 4 different countries from Latin America to Europe & the Middle East. As an artist, Kim dabbles in photography, furniture refinishing, painting, and ceramics, and stays busy with part-time property management, having fixed up and rented out 4 homes and a "Skoolie" over the years.

Production Team

Tim Leirness

PROJECT MANAGER

Tim has been in the remodeling industry for nearly 20 years and possesses extensive knowledge of both interior and exterior remodeling. Tim enthusiastically manages our projects with a friendly, client-centered approach. His organizational and communication skills are the key to keeping our operations running smoothly and our clients informed of the daily updates during the construction process. Tim is a devoted husband and father of two. In his free time, he enjoys working out, playing golf, and watching baseball.

Jhony Perez

PROJECT MANAGER, SITE SUPERVISOR

Jhony helps lead the team and supervises the projects. He is a skilled craftsman with over 20 years of experience. His kind and cheerful attitude is appreciated by our clients, who love having him on their projects. Jhony helps train the next generation to be as attentive to detail and proud of their work as he is. A fun fact about Jhony is that his family owns a coffee farm, he generously shares fresh coffee beans with the Wise Design family. Jhony is devoted to his wife and 3 daughters and recently became a Grandpa. 

Derrald Peterson

CABINET SPECIALIST

Derrald has been in the cabinet industry for over 40 years and brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the company. Over the years he has honed his cabinet making skills and partnered with many of the top designers in the Twin Cities, completing hundreds of kitchens and custom cabinetry projects. Derrald lives in Minneapolis, is happily married, and has 3 grown sons. He enjoys the outdoors, boating, and photography in his free time.

Nicholas Skarphol

TILING SPECIALIST 

Nick brings his passion for remodeling and expertise as both a Tiler and finish carpenter to the Wise Design Team. He pays close attention to the details and truly loves what he does. Nick’s friendly and caring attitude is always appreciated by our clients. He lives with his Fiancé and loves traveling and outdoor adventures.

Jonathan Kilian

FRAMING & CARPENTRY

Jonathan has come to us from Montpelier Vermont. He has been in the trades for over five years, with experience in the framing and flooring industries. His hobbies are playing guitar, camping, hiking, fly fishing and going to the gym. Jonathan has a passion and enthusiasm for remodeling and construction. He is such a great asset for our team that we forgive him for being a Boston Celtics fan (Go Wolves!).

Chris Dimitrievski

DRYWALL & CARPENTRY

Chris recently moved to the Twin Cities to be closer to his wife's family. His hobbies include Martial Arts, Hiking and Fishing (and remodeling). He is an avid tool collector and when it comes to tools, Chris follows this Mantra:  Better to have it and not need it, than need it and not have it! Chris loves all aspects of remodeling and is a fast learner. We are fortunate to have Chris on the team.

Administrative Team

Sheryll Storry

BOOKKEEPER

Sheryll has been with Wise Design and Remodel since 2018. She spent most of her career in public service, first teaching high school French, then working at Hennepin County, and later the Minnesota Department of Human Services.  After retiring in 2015, she went back to school to become a trained bookkeeper with a focus on the construction trades. While she loves working with numbers, her real passion is helping companies succeed by providing the necessary business intelligence gained from financial analysis. Some fun facts about Sheryll are that she’s an avid gardener, a grandma of 3 teen boys, and a world traveler. 

Julianne Hide

SHOWROOM MANAGER, DESIGN CONSULTANT

Julianne shares Philip’s passion for transforming homes into beautiful and functional living spaces. She helps manage the showroom at Wise Design and assists with designing. Julianne graduated from St. Kate’s University in St. Paul and met Phil in London during a term abroad. They married and lived together in London for 9 years before moving back to Minneapolis and continuing to raise their 3 kids here. Apart from the business, Julianne enjoys music and theatre, yoga and traveling, but most of all loves spending time with her family.

We look forward to hearing from you.

WHY FIVE FOLD
Why homeowners choose us, and why it matters

Hiring a contractor is a trust decision. You are letting someone into your home, your budget, and your schedule. Most homeowners we talk to have either had a bad experience before or are trying hard to avoid one. Here is how we approach the work differently.

01
Clarity Before Construction

We define scope, budget, and expectations before a single tool is picked up. That conversation protects you from surprises and protects us from doing work that was never agreed to. It is the most important part of the project, and most contractors rush past it.

02
Communication That Does Not Require Chasing

You will not have to wonder what is happening on your project. We set a communication cadence at the start and stick to it. Updates come to you, not the other way around.

03
Craftsmanship That Holds Up

We are careful about what we commit to and careful about how we build it. From structural work to finish details, the standard does not change based on what is visible or hidden.

04
We Deliver What We Agreed To

Scope creep, vague change orders, and after-the-fact surprises are where contractor relationships break down. We manage that proactively so the number you sign is the number you should expect to pay.

THE EXPERIENCE
A better remodeling experience

A well-run remodel is not an accident. It is the result of a defined process that handles the planning, communication, and execution in a way that keeps things organized from start to finish. Most contractors have a process. The difference is whether it actually protects the client.

01
Discover & Plan

We start with your goals, your space, and your budget. This conversation shapes everything that follows. We ask the questions most contractors skip.

02
Design & Scope

We define the work in detail before any agreement is signed. You know exactly what is included, what it costs, and what to expect before the project starts.

03
Build & Communicate

Work moves forward on a defined schedule with regular updates. If something comes up, we address it directly and promptly, not at the end of the job.

04
Final Walkthrough & Support

We close the project with a structured walkthrough, not a rushed handoff. You get a finished space and a clear record of the work that was done.

This Overland Park bathroom remodel started the way every project should: with a defined scope, a clear budget, and a homeowner who knew exactly what to expect before demo began. KANSAS CITY KITCHEN REMODELING

A Kitchen Designed Around the Way You Live

Five Fold Solutions plans and builds thoughtful kitchen renovations for Kansas City homeowners who value craftsmanship, clear communication, and a process they can trust.

Start Planning Your Kitchen
See How We Work

Thoughtful design. Clear expectations. Craftsmanship built to last.

Kansas City Area Contractor
Design-Build Guidance
Clear Project Communication
Licensed and Insured

DESIGNED FOR EVERYDAY LIFE

Your Kitchen Should Make Daily Life Better

A successful kitchen remodel improves more than finishes. It should make daily workflow easier, create useful storage, bring in better light, and give family and friends a natural place to gather.

What Homeowners Want
A layout that works better
More useful storage
Better lighting and finishes
A kitchen that fits the rest of the home
A space they are proud to share
What Homeowners Want to Avoid
Unclear pricing and scope
Poor communication
Endless delays
Design decisions made too late
Work that feels disconnected or unfinished

As a kitchen remodeling contractor, Five Fold uses a design-build process to create clarity before construction begins, when coordinated decisions have the greatest impact.

AFTER
BEFORE
DURING
DETAIL

FEATURED KITCHEN TRANSFORMATION

Small Changes, Meaningful Improvement

The homeowners did not need a kitchen that felt disconnected from the rest of their home. They needed a brighter, more useful space that improved everyday routines while still feeling natural within the existing house.

CHALLENGE

The existing kitchen felt visually heavy and did not make the best use of the available space.

DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION RESPONSE

We coordinated practical layout improvements, brighter materials, cabinetry, lighting, surfaces, and details that connect the kitchen to the surrounding rooms.

RESULT

The completed kitchen feels more open, useful, and intentional without losing its connection to the character of the home.

Improved visual flow
Brighter, cohesive finishes
Better everyday function

OUR PROCESS

A Clear Path From Early Ideas to Final Walkthrough
Initial Conversation

We discuss your goals, concerns, timing, and what is not working in the current kitchen.

Site Evaluation

We evaluate the space, existing conditions, layout opportunities, and potential project constraints.

Design and Scope Development

We refine the design direction, selections, scope, and investment expectations before construction begins.

Construction and Communication

Our team manages trades, shares progress, and protects the surrounding home.

Final Review

We complete a detailed walkthrough, address remaining items, and make sure the finished space is ready for daily life.

A defined process reduces surprises and gives homeowners clearer decisions at each stage.

KITCHEN REMODELING CAPABILITIES

One Team for the Details That Make the Kitchen Work
PLANNING AND DESIGN
Space planning and layout improvements
Cabinet replacement and custom cabinetry coordination
Appliance layout and installation coordination
Countertops, backsplash, and finish coordination
CONSTRUCTION
Structural modifications when required
Lighting and electrical updates
Plumbing fixture coordination
Flooring, painting, and finish carpentry
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
Permit and trade coordination
Project communication and sequencing
Quality review and final detailing
Project closeout

Final scope varies by project, existing conditions, design requirements, permitting, and selected materials.

HOW WE APPROACH REMODELING

Great Remodeling Begins Before Demolition

We do not believe a successful kitchen remodel begins with tearing out cabinets. It begins with listening.

Before construction, we learn how the kitchen functions today, what causes frustration, how the surrounding rooms are used, and what the finished space needs to accomplish.

Construction is one part of the work. Good remodeling also requires informed decisions, realistic expectations, and coordinated details.

“We are not only rebuilding a room. We are helping shape how a family experiences its home every day.”

WHY FIVE FOLD SOLUTIONS

Built With Care Before, During, and After Construction

For substantial Johnson County kitchen remodeling, the quality of the working relationship matters as much as the quality of the finishes.

01
Thoughtful Planning

We identify key decisions, requirements, and foreseeable challenges before construction.

02
Clear Communication

Homeowners should know what is happening, what comes next, and when input is needed.

03
Respect for Your Home

Remodeling is disruptive. We plan access, protection, cleanup, and jobsite expectations with the rest of your home in mind.

04
Craftsmanship With Accountability

Quality includes how details are coordinated, installed, reviewed, and completed.

Trust is built through consistent actions, honest conversations, and work that reflects care for both the home and the homeowner.

PROJECT EXPECTATIONS

What to Expect From a Full Kitchen Remodel
Planning

Cabinetry, appliances, plumbing, electrical, lighting, flooring, and finishes work together. They should be planned as one project, not isolated purchases.

Construction

The kitchen may be partially or fully unavailable during the work. Five Fold helps homeowners prepare for access limits, temporary routines, and sequencing.

Communication

Changes and unforeseen conditions can occur. The professional response is to explain them clearly and manage the decisions that follow.

PLANNING YOUR INVESTMENT

A Meaningful Kitchen Remodel Is More Than a Price Per Square Foot

Kitchen remodeling costs reflect the level of transformation, not square footage alone. Similar-sized kitchens can require different investments based on layout, cabinetry, structural work, trade requirements, materials, and existing conditions.

Rather than forcing every kitchen into a generic price-per-square-foot model, Five Fold develops the scope around the home, the homeowner’s priorities, and the level of transformation required.

This gives the homeowner a clearer understanding of what is included, which decisions affect the investment, and where trade-offs may exist before construction begins.

Discuss Your Project
Layout changes
Cabinetry
Countertops
Appliances
Electrical changes
Plumbing changes
Structural work

Existing conditions
Project complexity

IS THIS THE RIGHT TIME?

You May Be Ready to Remodel If…
The existing layout makes daily routines harder than they should be.
The kitchen no longer fits how your family cooks, gathers, or entertains.
You plan to remain in the home and want to invest in long-term function and enjoyment.
You are ready to make coordinated decisions rather than piecemeal cosmetic changes.

A full kitchen remodel is a meaningful commitment of time, attention, and investment. The right first step is not choosing finishes. It is determining whether the project, priorities, and expectations are aligned.

VERIFIED CLIENT TESTIMONIAL
Had a great experience working with Five Fold Solutions. Great people doing great work. Paid attention to details and stayed in touch throughout this project.
Mike, Overland Park, KS
KITCHEN REMODEL

Planning a Kitchen Remodel With Confidence
How much does a kitchen remodel cost?

Kitchen remodeling costs vary based on layout changes, cabinetry, surfaces, appliances, trade work, structural requirements, and finish selections. Five Fold develops project-specific scope and investment expectations rather than relying on a generic number alone.

KANSAS CITY BATHROOM REMODELING

Most bathroom remodel problems start before demo day.

Five Fold plans, builds, and manages the details that determine whether the finished bathroom simply looks better or actually works better.

Start Planning Your Bathroom
See Our Work
SERVICE AREA
Johnson County + Greater Kansas City
FIRST STEP
A focused 10–15 minute conversation
APPROACH
Planning, scope, selections + construction coordination

FIVE FOLD PROJECT PHOTOGRAPHY

PLAN THE ROOM, NOT JUST THE FINISHES

Bathroom remodeling built around the way you live.

A bathroom can be visually dated and still have a deeper problem: the room no longer supports the way your household starts and ends the day.

For homeowners across Johnson County and the Kansas City metro, remodeling is an opportunity to reconsider layout, storage, lighting, ventilation, shower or tub access, plumbing fixtures, and the use of every square foot not simply replace what is already there.

Poor layout or difficult circulation
Inadequate storage and counter space
Aging finishes or deteriorated materials
Shower and tub configurations that no longer fit
Lighting, ventilation, or fixture concerns
Square footage that could work harder

FEATURED FIVE FOLD PROJECT

One room, rebuilt from the inside out.

This real photo sequence follows the room from its earlier finishes to the completed bathroom. The visual change is the result; the preparation, sequencing, and coordination shown in the record are what make that finish possible.

EARLIER CONDITION
COMPLETED ROOM
STARTING POINT
An enclosed shower and aging surfaces defined the room.

The earlier photographs show blue square tile, patterned wallcovering, open shelving, a single vanity, and a framed shower enclosure.

WORK VISIBLE IN THE RECORD
Preparation and sequencing came before the finish.

The construction photographs show wallboard, shower-area preparation, floor and wall tile installation, a recessed niche, and finish stage coordination.

FINISHED RESULT
A brighter palette now reads as one connected room.

White wall tile, small-format shower-floor tile, stone-look flooring, blue-gray walls, a white vanity, and a glass enclosure now read as one room.

A REAL PROJECT IN PROGRESS

See a bathroom remodel take shape.

Finished photography matters. So does the work that comes before it. These images show the visible progression without assigning an unsupported schedule, product specification, or trade claim.

01
Before

The existing room and its finish relationships are documented before construction.

02
Cleared + prepared

Finished surfaces are gone and the room is ready for the next layers.

03
Wall + ceiling preparation

Board, seams, openings, and room surfaces begin to define the build.

04
Shower preparation

The shower base, curb, drain, and prepared wall surfaces take shape before wall tile.

05
Tile installation

Wall tile, shower-floor tile, niche, curb, and room flooring establish the finish geometry.

06
Glass + finish coordination

The enclosure is in place while the vanity and remaining room details continue.

07
Completed bathroom

The finished vanity, lighting, paint, flooring, glass, tile and hardware come together as one coordinated room.

BATHROOM REMODELING SCOPE

The room works when every layer works together.

Five Fold can shape the right scope around the existing room, homeowner priorities, and the decisions that need to be resolved before construction.

01

Plan the space
Primary, guest + hall bathrooms
Layout modifications
Walk-in showers
Tub-to-shower conversions when appropriate
Vanities, cabinetry + storage

02

Coordinate the systems
Plumbing fixture coordination
Lighting + electrical coordination
Ventilation considerations
Trade sequencing
Material and selection coordination

03

Complete the finishes
Custom tile + flooring
Shower surrounds + niches
Drywall + paint
Finish carpentry
Fixtures, hardware + closeout details

THE FIVE FOLD PROCESS

A clear path from first conversation to closeout.

Each project earns its scope. The process is designed to surface the important decisions early and keep communication clear as the work moves forward.

01
Tell us about the project

Share the room, the problems you want to solve, and what is prompting the remodel.

02
10–15 minute conversation

We discuss priorities, general scope, location, timing considerations, and whether the project appears to be a fit.

03
On-site walkthrough

If the project appears aligned, the next step is a closer look at the room, existing conditions, and practical opportunities.

04
Scope, planning + selections

Layout, materials, fixtures, coordination needs, and expectations are developed into the appropriate planning path.

05
Construction + coordination

Five Fold manages the agreed scope, schedule, material flow, communication, and trade sequencing through construction.

06
Closeout

The project concludes with final details, a walkthrough, and a clear review of the completed work.

Transitions, edges and interfaces are part of the project—not afterthoughts.

WHY FIVE FOLD

The visible finish depends on the work you do not see.
Decisions before demolition

Layout, selections, plumbing, electrical needs, waterproofing approach, material coordination, and sequencing are addressed as parts of one plan.

One accountable remodeling partner

Homeowners have one team responsible for keeping scope, communication, schedule, materials, and trade coordination connected.

Attention from rough work through closeout

The project is managed across the hidden layers, finish interfaces, final details, and walkthrough—not only the most photogenic moments.

BATHROOM INVESTMENT

The right budget starts with the right scope.

A useful bathroom-remodel conversation should explain what drives the investment—not force every room into a range before the details are understood.

Common investment drivers
ROOM
Size, existing conditions and access
LAYOUT
Wall changes and plumbing relocation
SHOWER
System, size, glass and tile complexity
STORAGE
Vanity, cabinetry and custom details
SYSTEMS
Lighting, electrical and ventilation needs
SELECTIONS
Fixtures, tile, flooring and finish level

After the room and priorities are understood, Five Fold can guide the appropriate scope and planning path before construction begins.

QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU REMODEL

Useful answers, before the work begins.

Every bathroom and jurisdiction is different. These answers outline how Five Fold approaches the early conversation without promising a scope before seeing the room.

ABOUT FIVE FOLD SOLUTIONS

Built on Trust. Crafted with Intention.

Remodeling should feel organized and honest, not stressful and uncertain. That’s how we approach every project, from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

Start the Conversation

FOUNDING STORY

From Shared Values to a Stronger Building Experience

Five Fold Solutions began with a conversation between two friends who first connected through a church men’s group and discovered a shared belief about how building should be done. Jason brought years of hands-on craftsmanship and field experience. Max brought a background in business strategy, systems, and operations. Together, they saw an opportunity to build a company where structure and craft could work side by side.

From the beginning, the goal was not simply to complete projects. It was to create a better building experience, shaped by honesty, clear communication, and respect for the people trusting us with their homes or businesses.

Since launching in March 2024, Five Fold has grown from a small network of trusted trades into a deeper team with stronger processes and broader capabilities. The foundation hasn’t changed: lead with integrity, communicate clearly, and treat every client’s project like it matters, because it does.

LEADERSHIP

Meet the Team Leading Your Project

A successful project takes more than good craftsmanship. It takes clear communication, thoughtful planning, and leadership that keeps the client experience at the center from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

MAX FARMER

Co-Founder • Business Strategy & Growth

Building the company behind every successful project.

Max leads the business strategy, financial oversight, marketing, and operational systems that keep Five Fold Solutions moving forward. His focus is building the structure behind a better client experience, clearer expectations, stronger follow-through, and fewer surprises along the way.

JASON LUCE

Co-Founder • Client Experience & Production

Guiding clients from first conversation to final walkthrough.

Jason guides clients from the first conversation through project completion, helping transform ideas into spaces that reflect how people live and work. He leads production with a focus on craftsmanship, communication, and an exceptional client experience from beginning to end.

Together, Max and Jason lead Five Fold Solutions with complementary strengths, one focused on the business behind the project, the other focused on the job site itself. Clients get both.

CRAFTSMANSHIP & PROCESS

Craftsmanship Is More Than the Final Result

Good finish work starts long before the trim goes up. It starts with the right plan, the right people, and a process that holds every phase to the same standard, from demo to final walkthrough.

We work across a full range of projects, including kitchen and bathroom remodels, whole-house renovations, additions, outdoor living spaces, and light commercial improvements. Whether residential or commercial, every project is guided by the same principles: clear planning, steady communication, and work we are proud to stand behind.

TEAM & EXECUTION

A Team-Oriented Approach to Building

Every person on a Five Fold project is someone we know, trust, and would confidently put our name behind. We build with local people who take their work seriously because their reputation is on the line just as much as ours.

We are selective about who we bring onto a job. That means experienced people who communicate well, respect the client’s space, and hold themselves to a high standard on site. When the team operates that way, the project runs smoother and the client feels the difference.

Outdoor Living Designed for Real Kansas City Life

Custom decks, screened porches, and covered spaces planned around your home and the way you live.

Custom decks, pergolas & porches built for Kansas City living.
Ready for Better Outdoor Living?

An empty or outdated backyard can limit how much you enjoy your home. Poor shade, an awkward layout, or worn materials may keep your family indoors even when the weather is pleasant.

Five Fold Solutions creates outdoor living spaces that feel like a natural part of your home. We plan the design and manage the construction, giving you one reliable team from the first conversation through the final walkthrough. Turn unused outdoor space into a place you will enjoy every day.

SCHEDULE YOUR OUTDOOR LIVING CONSULTATION
Case Study: Backyard Oasis in Overland Park

A disconnected backyard reimagined into a luxurious outdoor living space

Spaces Designed Around Your Life

Your outdoor area should support how you relax and entertain. We design each project around your property, personal style, and plans for the space.

Our team can create:

Custom decks built with composite materials or natural wood

Screened porches for added comfort and protection

Covered patios that provide dependable shade

Pergolas that add structure and visual interest

Railings, stairs, and connected seating areas

Complete backyard spaces with several coordinated features

Every feature should look intentional and serve a clear purpose.

Built for Kansas City Homes and Weather

Kansas City weather places real demands on outdoor materials. Heat, rain, and cold temperatures can expose weak construction or poor material choices.

We help homeowners compare cedar and composite decking based on appearance, care needs, and long-term use. As an experienced deck builder and screened porch contractor, we also consider drainage, structural support, and safe access throughout the design. Strong planning creates a space that performs as well as it looks.

One Team From Design Through Construction

Five Fold Solutions uses a clear design-build process that keeps the project organized. You receive defined expectations and regular communication without needing to chase several contractors for answers.

Discover: We discuss your goals, property, and expected investment.

Plan: We develop the layout and help select suitable materials.

Define: We confirm the scope, pricing, and project expectations.

Build: Our team completes the work with careful attention to every detail.

Review: We conduct a final walkthrough and address remaining questions.

You know what is happening before construction begins.

How We Build

A Backyard Built to Last. Watch This Outdoor Transformation Unfold

What Our Customers Say

Homeowners choose Five Fold Solutions because they want honest communication and dependable craftsmanship. Their experiences show what a well-planned remodeling project should feel like. Clear expectations lead to greater confidence throughout the project.

What Does an Outdoor Project Cost?

Pricing depends on the size, materials, site conditions, and features included in the design. A simple deck has different needs than a covered porch with lighting and several connected areas.

We discuss your budget early and define the complete scope before construction. This approach gives you a realistic project price based on your actual plans.

Create a Backyard Worth Coming Home To

Five Fold Solutions serves Johnson County and communities throughout the Kansas City metro area. Our licensed and insured team combines careful planning, clear communication, and proven craftsmanship to create lasting outdoor living spaces.

Schedule your consultation and start planning a backyard built around you.

We specialize in custom decks, covered patios, pergolas, screened porches, and full outdoor living spaces. Whether you want a quiet morning coffee spot or an entertainer’s dream setup, we build with both form and function in mind.

Outdoor Living Designed for Real Kansas City Life

Ready for Better Outdoor Living?

An empty or outdated backyard can limit how much you enjoy your home. Poor shade, an awkward layout, or worn materials may keep your family indoors even when the weather is pleasant.

Five Fold Solutions creates outdoor living spaces that feel like a natural part of your home. We plan the design and manage the construction, giving you one reliable team from the first conversation through the final walkthrough. Turn unused outdoor space into a place you will enjoy every day.

SCHEDULE YOUR OUTDOOR LIVING CONSULTATION
Case Study: Backyard Oasis in Overland Park

A disconnected backyard reimagined into a luxurious outdoor living space

Spaces Designed Around Your Life

Your outdoor area should support how you relax and entertain. We design each project around your property, personal style, and plans for the space.

Our team can create:

Custom decks built with composite materials or natural wood

Screened porches for added comfort and protection

Covered patios that provide dependable shade

Pergolas that add structure and visual interest

Railings, stairs, and connected seating areas

Complete backyard spaces with several coordinated features

Every feature should look intentional and serve a clear purpose.

Built for Kansas City Homes and Weather

Kansas City weather places real demands on outdoor materials. Heat, rain, and cold temperatures can expose weak construction or poor material choices.

We help homeowners compare cedar and composite decking based on appearance, care needs, and long-term use. As an experienced deck builder and screened porch contractor, we also consider drainage, structural support, and safe access throughout the design. Strong planning creates a space that performs as well as it looks.

One Team From Design Through Construction

Five Fold Solutions uses a clear design-build process that keeps the project organized. You receive defined expectations and regular communication without needing to chase several contractors for answers.

Discover: We discuss your goals, property, and expected investment.

Plan: We develop the layout and help select suitable materials.

Define: We confirm the scope, pricing, and project expectations.

Build: Our team completes the work with careful attention to every detail.

Review: We conduct a final walkthrough and address remaining questions.

You know what is happening before construction begins.

Whole Home Renovations Designed Around Your Life

Transform your current house into a more useful, comfortable, and connected home with Five Fold Solutions.

Does Your Home Still Work for You?

A poor layout can make daily life harder than it needs to be. Closed rooms, limited storage, and outdated spaces may keep your house from serving your family well.

Five Fold Solutions provides whole-home renovations for homeowners throughout Johnson County and the greater Kansas City Metro. We bring the design and construction work together, allowing every part of the home to feel connected.

START PLANNING YOUR RENOVATION
House need a facelift? 

Before

or maybe you’re seeing some drooping

Create One Complete Vision for Your Home

Updating several spaces at once requires careful planning. As an experienced design-build contractor, we study how each room connects before construction begins.

Our remodeling contractor team can coordinate projects that include:

Kitchen remodeling with improved storage and flow

Bathroom remodeling focused on comfort and function

Basement finishing that creates useful living space

Home additions for growing families

New flooring, lighting, and interior finishes

Layout changes that improve movement between rooms

We can also connect indoor areas with a new deck or screened porch. This approach creates a consistent design instead of making each space feel like a separate project. One clear plan keeps the entire renovation moving in the same direction.

Why Choose Five Fold Solutions?

A major renovation involves more than selecting cabinets or paint colors. It requires clear decisions about the layout, structural work, materials, and budget.

Five Fold Solutions defines the project scope before construction begins. Our team also provides regular updates, coordinates trusted trades, and documents changes in writing. You will know what is included before work gets underway.

We are licensed and insured, with experience serving homeowners across the Kansas City area. Our work is guided by integrity, careful stewardship, and respect for your property.

How Do Whole Home Renovations Work?

Every successful renovation begins with a strong plan. We guide you through each stage so you can make informed choices with confidence.

Discovery: We discuss your goals, current concerns, preferred style, and investment range.

Design: We develop the layout and define the materials needed for a complete home transformation.

Planning: We confirm the project scope, expected schedule, and construction details.

Construction: Our team manages the work while keeping you informed throughout the build.

Final Review: We inspect the completed spaces with you and address final details.

A defined process replaces uncertainty with clear expectations.

Our Commitment to Whole-Home Craftsmanship
Purpose-driven renovations, transparent from day one.

At Five Fold Solutions, we don’t just update rooms, we realign the entire home around the way you live. That means honest pricing without surprise change-order, daily communication you can count on, and vetted trades who treat your house like their own. 

Whether we’re removing walls, reframing traffic flow, or rebuilding from the studs up, every decision is rooted in integrity, stewardship, and long-term value. The result? Spaces that feel cohesive on day one and still make sense years down the road.

What Does a Whole Home Renovation Cost?

Pricing depends on the size of the home and the amount of structural work involved. Layout changes, home additions, and custom finishes can also affect the total investment.

We provide detailed pricing based on the agreed scope. This gives you a clearer understanding of where your money is going before construction starts.

Build a Home That Finally Fits

Five Fold Solutions manages complex whole home renovations through one coordinated plan, one accountable team, and one clear construction process. Contact us to schedule a consultation and begin creating a home that works better for the way you live.

No two whole-home remodels are alike. Your investment depends on how much transformation you're looking for, from layout changes to custom finishes. We help you align the budget with what matters most, and we break down every detail so nothing’s left to guesswork.

Olathe Kitchen Remodel with Updated Finishes

Cabinet refacing, new quartz counters, appliances, and tile for a space that works and feels brand new.

Olathe, KS
Cabinets + Hardware + Countertops + Appliances
6 Weeks
0 Surprises
Client Challenge

The homeowners craved a brighter, more contemporary kitchen but needed to stay within a tight budget. A full gut-renovation was off the table, so every dollar had to count. The must-keep items, original base cabinets and existing hardwood floors, added complexity: the old laminate countertop had to be removed without damaging the cabinetry, and any new finishes needed to blend seamlessly with the preserved elements while still delivering a modern feel.

Our Solution

We started by carefully detaching the countertop in sections, protecting the base cabinets and saving the client the cost of replacement. Fresh Shaker-style cabinet faces, matte-black hardware, and a subway-tile backsplash introduced timeless character, while durable quartz counters and a suite of energy-efficient stainless appliances provided the functional upgrade the family wanted. By focusing spend on high-impact surfaces and re-using solid underlying assets, we delivered a light-filled, modern kitchen that met both aesthetic goals and budget proving you don’t have to start from scratch to achieve a stunning transformation

Key Features & Materials

We blended timeless finishes with budget-smart upgrades, delivering a bright, durable kitchen you can cook in, live in, and love for years.

Kitchen Remodeling

Whether you're opening up a closed-off galley or refreshing the finishes in a colonial, we handle the full scope from design through final walkthrough. Our cabinetry is custom-built by Amish craftsmen right here in Ohio, and every project includes 3D renderings so you can see the finished kitchen before we start demo. From countertop selection and lighting design to appliance planning and finish carpentry, it's all coordinated under one roof.

KITCHEN REMODELING IN COLUMBUS, OHIO →

Whole Home Renovation

Modernize a historic home or reimagine a newer build. We coordinate every trade so you don't have to.

A whole-home remodel brings everything together — kitchen, baths, living spaces, flooring, trim, and finishes — into one cohesive design. Instead of tackling rooms one at a time with different contractors, you get a single team managing the full project from concept to completion. We help you figure out which walls can move, where storage should go, and how to make the flow of your home match how you actually live in it. 

WHOLE HOME REMODELING IN COLUMBUS, OHIO →

Spa-inspired primary baths, functional hall baths, and elegant powder rooms — with thoughtful tile, plumbing, and lighting choices throughout.

We design bathrooms that hold up to daily life and still feel like a retreat. Walk-in showers with frameless glass and custom tile work, heated floors, freestanding tubs, built-in storage that keeps countertops clean — it's all planned in detail before construction starts. Whether it's a full primary suite overhaul or a tub-to-shower conversion, every project is waterproofed, permitted, and built to last.

Bathroom Remodeling

BATHROOM REMODELING IN COLUMBUS, OHIO →

Basement Finishing

Custom basement finishing designed for entertaining, everyday living, and added home value.

A finished basement adds real, usable square footage to your home — whether that's a family room, home office, guest suite, gym, or all of the above. We handle the full build from framing and electrical to flooring, trim, and a full bathroom if you need one. That includes cutting and trenching the slab for plumbing, managing moisture with proper waterproofing and ventilation, and designing a layout that feels like a natural extension of the rest of your house. Thoughtful layouts, premium materials, and clear communication from start to finish.

WHY E L E V A T E

One Team. Design through Final Walkthrough. 

Most remodeling companies hand your project off to a different crew at every stage — one person sells it, someone else designs it, and a rotating cast of subs builds it. At Elevate, you work with the same small team from your first conversation through the day we hand you the keys.

Michael Freed, the owner, is personally involved in every project. He's been in the remodeling industry since 2012 and has hands-on construction experience — he understands what's behind your walls, what a realistic timeline looks like, and how to solve problems before they become expensive surprises. That field knowledge is baked into every design decision, material recommendation, and budget conversation.

Here's what that means in practice: you get 3D renderings before we start demo so there are no surprises. You get a dedicated point of contact who actually knows the status of your project. You get Amish-crafted custom cabinetry built to order in Ohio — not pulled from a catalog. And you get honest communication about budget, timeline, and scope from the very first meeting.

We're licensed and insured in the State of Ohio, and we carry a 4.9-star rating on Google with consistent five-star reviews.

This is your home. You deserve a remodeling experience that respects your time, your investment, and your trust.

Elevate Remodeling is a Columbus, Ohio design-build remodeling company. We specialize in kitchen remodeling in Columbus, bathroom remodeling in Columbus, basement finishing and whole home remodels. Neighborhoods we serve: Upper Arlington, Dublin, Powell, Bexley, Grandview Heights, Clintonville, Worthington, Westerville, New Albany, Hilliard, Gahanna, Lewis Center, Delaware, Galena, Plain City and surrounding neighborhoods. Our Kitchen Renovation Process

Every kitchen renovation we do in Columbus follows the same five stages, so you always know what's happening and what comes next.

1. Consultation. We walk the space, talk through how you cook and gather and what isn't working about the current layout, and get a clear read on your budget range before we design anything. It's an in-home visit, not a showroom appointment — we come to you.

2. Design and selections. Layout drawings and 3D renderings first, then cabinetry, countertops, backsplash, appliances, flooring, and lighting. You see the finished kitchen before demo starts. For fully custom cabinets we produce shop drawings, and nothing gets built until you approve them — that approval locks in both your design and your price.

3. Permits. We pull the permits and schedule the inspections with the right jurisdiction. Columbus, Upper Arlington, Dublin, and Worthington each run their own review process on their own timeline, and we build those into your schedule rather than discovering them mid-project.

4. Construction. Demo, framing, rough-in plumbing, electrical and HVAC, insulation, drywall, cabinetry and finish carpentry, countertops, tile, flooring, paint, finish electrical and plumbing, appliance install, final clean. One team, one point of contact, and an organized jobsite at the end of every day.

5. Walkthrough. We go through the finished kitchen with you and close out the punch list before we call it done.

Why Columbus Homeowners Hire Elevate for Kitchen Remodeling

A kitchen remodel puts your household out of commission for months and touches structure, plumbing, gas, and electrical. Who does the work matters more than what it costs.

A decade in Central Ohio. Elevate was founded in 2016 by Michael Freed, a Columbus native and Ohio State graduate. We've been remodeling kitchens in these neighborhoods long enough to know what's behind the walls before we open them.

Licensed and insured. All mechanical work is completed by licensed tradespeople and inspected before we close walls. We carry full insurance and offer a one-year warranty.

The owner runs your project. Michael is on your job from the first walkthrough to the final punch list. You're not handed off to a project manager who wasn't in the design conversation.

An exact quote, not a range. After the consultation we create a 3D rendering of your proposed layout and give you a real number tied to a real plan. That number only changes if you choose to add scope. We don't do the under-scope-now, change-order-later routine that wrecks other people's remodels.

Cabinetry built in Ohio. Our cabinets are fully custom and Amish-made in the U.S.

Bathroom Remodel Cost in Columbus, Ohio

What a bathroom remodel costs in Columbus comes down to three things: the size of the room, whether the layout changes, and the finish level you choose. A cosmetic refresh that reuses existing plumbing locations sits at the low end. A primary bath where the shower and vanity trade places — new drain lines, new supply, new framing — sits at the top.

We price every bathroom to its actual scope — no per-square-foot shortcuts, no menu pricing. After a walkthrough we put together a line-item estimate so you can see where the money goes and adjust before anything gets ordered. That said, you deserve a real number before you pick up the phone. Here's where the bathrooms we build in Columbus actually land.

PROJECT TYPE	TYPICAL INVESTMENT (2026)	EST. CONSTRUCTION*

Powder Room / Cosmetic Refresh
	$15,000 – $35,000	2–4 weeks
