CUSTOM CABINETS

From inspiration to installation for any room in your home. We offer many cabinet selections from high quality cabinet manufacturers with a large variety of styles and finishes. Are you looking for something unique? Consider our custom cabinetry which we will custom design, build and finish just for you to get that special style and look you are dreaming of. Call to scheduled an appointment with a design specialist to discuss our remodeling services.

FLOORING

Your Dream Remodeling has a wide variety of flooring options to meet your needs. Our experts will help you select the right flooring for all of your projects. We carry high quality flooring from major manufacturers including hardwood, luxury vinyl wood-look and water-resistant vinyl, porcelain tile, carpet, laminate, and engineered wood. Call our showroom to make an appointment to discuss our remodeling services or to schedule a free in-home consultation.

COUNTERTOPS

We offer a wide selection of countertop materials to transform your space into work of art. The many countertop options include quartz, granite, marble, concrete, wood and more. Our design specialists will discuss pros and cons of each type of material for your specific project. They will help you select edging finishes such as straight, bullnose, beveled etc. to get the look you desire.

builds tend to have larger kitchens with more layout flexibility, which means bigger opportunity for waterfall islands and dual-toned cabinet designs.

homes often need updated plumbing along with the cosmetic remodel because of their age and original build spec.

KITCHEN REMODELING • CYPRESS, TEXAS
Kitchen Remodeling in Cypress, TX - Cabinets, Countertops, Islands and Custom Layouts

A kitchen remodel should make your home easier to live in, not simply newer to look at. Your Dream Remodeling provides kitchen remodeling in Cypress, TX for homeowners planning everything from cabinet and countertop upgrades to full kitchen renovations, new islands, open layouts and complete gut remodels. Cypress homes create very different remodeling decisions depending on where and when they were built. An established Fairfield or Coles Crossing kitchen may be reaching the point where the original cabinetry, lighting, tile and layout all need attention. A newer home in Bridgeland or Towne Lake may already have an open floor plan but still feel builder-standard rather than personal. Those projects should not receive the same remodeling plan. We begin by figuring out what is actually holding the kitchen back, then coordinate the layout, cabinetry, appliances, surfaces, lighting and construction scope around those priorities. Homeowners who want to understand our broader approach can also explore our kitchen remodeling services in Houston. Kitchen remodeling projects starting from $25,000

Schedule a Free In-Home Consultation
Call 281-550-8900
CYPRESS SERVICE AREA
Kitchen Remodeling Across Cypress, TX

We serve homeowners throughout the Cypress area, including ZIP codes 77429, 77433 and 77095.

includes:

PLAN AROUND THE HOUSE YOU ACTUALLY HAVE
Cypress Kitchens Do Not All Need the Same Remodel

Cypress did not develop all at once,
and that creates different kitchen problems.

Established Cypress Homes

In established communities such as
Fairfield, Coles Crossing, Longwood and parts of Copperfield, common problems
can include:

Dated cabinet configurations
Limited drawer storage
Older lighting layouts
Small pantry space
Peninsula layouts
Flooring that stops at old cabinet footprints
Appliance openings sized around older equipment

In those kitchens, changing one finish at a time can become expensive without resolving the underlying layout.

Newer Cypress Homes

Homes in Bridgeland, Towne Lake and
Cypress Creek Lakes may already have larger kitchens, open living spaces and
relatively modern infrastructure.

The homeowners may be trying to turn
a builder kitchen into something more personal through:

Better cabinet organization
Taller cabinetry
Redesigned islands
Premium countertops
Better lighting
Custom range hood treatments
Beverage or coffee stations
Improved pantry storage

The better plan may preserve much of
the footprint while investing more of the budget in finishes and storage
features.

FULL-SERVICE REMODELING
Cypress Kitchen Remodeling Services

A successful Cypress kitchen remodeling project starts by defining the right level of work.

A complete remodel may include:

Cabinet replacement
Cabinet layout redesign
Quartz or natural stone countertops
New kitchen island
Pantry redesign
Backsplash
Flooring
Lighting
Fixtures
Appliance planning
Plumbing changes
Electrical upgrades
Wall modifications
Painting
Finish carpentry

Your appliance specifications can inform the cabinet drawings. The cabinet plan can determine the lighting layout. Flooring can be planned around the new footprint rather than patched after construction.

One Coordinated Scope
Cabinetry • Countertops • Island • Flooring • Lighting • Utilities • Finish Work
Plan Your Cypress Kitchen Remodel
LAYOUT PLANNING
Kitchen Layout Redesign in Cypress

A beautiful kitchen can still be frustrating if circulation is wrong.

Before changing the footprint, we look at:

Refrigerator door swing
Dishwasher clearance
Oven and range access
Sink location
Pantry traffic
Island seating
Walkways
Drawer and cabinet clearance

One of the most common design problems is trying to force too much into the center of the room. An oversized island can look impressive on a rendering and become irritating when the dishwasher, refrigerator and bar stools compete for the same walkway. We design around movement first.

OPEN-CONCEPT REMODELING
Open-Concept Kitchen Remodeling in Cypress

If you are considering opening the kitchen further, the first question should not be what the new island looks like.

It should be what the wall is doing.

A wall may contain:

Structural framing
Electrical wiring
Plumbing
HVAC components
Switches and outlets
Flooring and ceiling transitions

If it is load-bearing, structural evaluation may be required before the final kitchen design is approved.

The cost of removing a wall can also include flooring, ceiling repair, lighting and cabinet redesign.

Ask About Opening Your Kitchen
CUSTOM CABINETRY
Custom Kitchen Cabinets in Cypress, TX

Cabinetry is often the largest single component of the kitchen budget. Before choosing a door style, we look at what your existing storage is failing to do. Your Dream Remodeling works with cabinet manufacturers including:

J&K Cabinetry
Venus Cabinets
US Cabinets Depot
Wolf Home Products

Hardware and storage systems can
incorporate products from Richelieu.

Depending on the kitchen, we can plan:

Deep drawer bases
Pull-out shelves
Pantry storage
Tray dividers
Waste and recycling pull-outs
Appliance storage
Island drawers
Full-height cabinetry
Should You Reface or Replace Your Cabinets?

Refacing can make sense when the existing cabinet boxes are solid, the kitchen layout works and the problem is primarily cosmetic. Replacement makes more sense when storage is poor, appliance locations are changing, cabinets are damaged or the kitchen needs a different footprint. Visit our kitchen design showroom to compare cabinet styles, finishes and material combinations.

SURFACES & ISLANDS
Kitchen Countertops & Islands

Available surfaces may include:

Quartz
Granite
Quartzite
Marble
Porcelain
Solid-surface materials
Specialty Onyx applications

Our countertop and surface relationships include:

Cosentino | Silestone | Wilsonart | Onyx Collection

Countertop planning should consider maintenance, seams, island size, sinks, edges, backsplash and cabinet color.

For kitchen islands, we also check:

Refrigerator doors
Dishwasher doors
Oven doors
Pantry entries
Cabinet drawers
Seating clearance
Main household traffic

A successful island improves the kitchen when several people are using the room at once.

NEWER CYPRESS HOMES
Builder-Grade Kitchen Upgrades in Bridgeland, Towne Lake & Cypress Creek Lakes

A newer kitchen does not necessarily need a complete gut remodel. Sometimes the room is functionally sound but visually generic. In that situation, we first identify which parts of the original kitchen are worth preserving. Maybe the cabinet layout is good but storage needs improvement. Maybe the island is the right size but the countertop and lighting feel standard. Maybe the cabinets are acceptable but leave awkward unused space above. The goal is not to demolish good work for the sake of having a full remodel. For homeowners planning a Bridgeland kitchen remodel, Towne Lake remodel or kitchen renovation in Cypress Creek Lakes, this distinction can make the difference between a strategic upgrade and an unnecessarily expensive rebuild.

ESTABLISHED CYPRESS HOMES
Remodeling Established Kitchens in Fairfield, Coles Crossing & Longwood

Older Cypress communities often present a different set of decisions.

Common priorities can include:

Replacing aging cabinetry
Converting lower cabinets to drawers
Improving pantry storage
Updating lighting
Creating a larger island
Removing a peninsula
Opening the kitchen toward the living area
Replacing dated flooring
Planning for larger refrigerators or ranges

If the existing footprint works, keeping it can save significant money.

If it is the source of the kitchen’s problems, covering it with expensive new finishes simply locks those problems in.

PRE-CONSTRUCTION PLANNING
What Should Be Checked Before a Cypress Kitchen Remodel?

Good remodeling planning also means identifying conditions that can disrupt the design later.

Electrical Requirements

Modern appliances and lighting can change circuit requirements.

Plumbing

Moving the sink, dishwasher or refrigerator water connection can increase scope.

Range Hood Ventilation

Cooking equipment and ventilation should be planned together.

Flooring

Changing cabinet or island footprints can expose areas where flooring never existed.

Structural Changes

Wall removal should be evaluated structurally before cabinet and island plans depend on the opening.

Appliance Dimensions

Appliances should be selected before final cabinet drawings.

PERMITS & HOA PLANNING
Cypress Remodeling Permits: What Homeowners Should Know

Cypress is not an incorporated city with its own municipal building department. Most Cypress properties are within unincorporated Harris County, so applicable residential permitting is handled through Harris County rather than a “City of Cypress” permit office. Exactly what approvals are required depends on the property and scope of work. Individual communities can also have deed restrictions or HOA architectural-review requirements. In master-planned areas such as Bridgeland, Towne Lake, Fairfield and Coles Crossing, homeowners should confirm whether the planned scope requires community approval in addition to any applicable county process. County permits and HOA approvals are separate considerations.

BUDGET PLANNING
How Much Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Cypress, TX?

One Cypress kitchen might keep every major utility in place. Another might remove walls, relocate plumbing and install premium cabinetry and appliances. Those are not comparable projects.

FULL KITCHEN RENOVATION
Full Kitchen Remodeling & Gut Renovation in Cypress, TX

Homeowners searching for a gut renovation in Cypress are usually dealing with a kitchen where keeping the existing configuration no longer makes sense.

A gut remodel can involve removing:

Existing cabinetry
Countertops
Backsplash
Flooring
Drywall in affected areas
Lighting
Outdated fixtures

A full kitchen remodeling project in Cypress, TX makes the most sense when several major components need to
change at once.

If the room already has a strong footprint and usable infrastructure, selective remodeling may deliver a better result with less disruption.

FROM FIRST VISIT TO FINAL WALKTHROUGH
Our Cypress Kitchen Remodeling Process
01
Free In-Home Consultation

We measure the room and discuss layout, storage, island size, appliances, walls and budget.

02
Layout & Kitchen Design

Cabinet locations, appliance positions and island dimensions are planned around actual measurements.

06

COMPARE THE SCOPE, NOT JUST THE NUMBER
Kitchen Remodelers in Cypress, TX: What Should You Compare?

When homeowners compare kitchen remodelers in Cypress, TX, estimates can look similar until the details are examined.

Ask:

Which cabinet manufacturer and line are specified?
What countertop material or allowance is included?
Are demolition and disposal included?
Who handles required permits?
Who performs licensed trade work?
Is structural evaluation included where needed?
How are concealed conditions handled?
How are change orders approved?
What is excluded?
Is there a written warranty?
Can you visit a physical showroom?
Can you see completed kitchens?

When comparing kitchen remodelers in Cypress, the lowest number only matters if the proposals describe the same work.

CHOOSING A CONTRACTOR
Choosing a Remodeling Company in Cypress

A professional remodeling company in Cypress should be willing to explain when an idea adds value and when it simply adds cost.

Sometimes relocating the sink is worth it.

Sometimes it creates additional work without improving the room enough to justify it.

Sometimes a wall should come down.

BATHROOM REMODELING NEAR ME
Bathroom Remodeling Near Me: A Local Team You Can Actually Visit

Searching “near me” usually means you want three things. Someone close enough to show up on time. Someone real enough to have a front door. Someone who’ll still be around if you need them after the job is done.

Your Dream Remodeling has a showroom at 1718 N Fry Rd, Suite 330, in West Houston. We’ve been remodeling bathrooms across Greater Houston since 2014, and you’re welcome to stop by Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm.

Book a Free In-Home Visit
Call 281-550-8900
Get Directions
YOUR DREAM REMODELING
What You’re Really Worried About (And How We Handle It)

We hear the same concerns from almost every homeowner who calls. Most of them come from a bad experience with a past contractor, or a friend’s.

“
“What if they disappear halfway through?”

We have a physical showroom and have operated in Houston for over a decade. You know where we are.

“
“I don’t know who’ll be in my house.”

Our in-house crew does the remodeling, and a production manager checks every stage. Plumbing is done by plumbers licensed through the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners, and electrical by electricians licensed through TDLR, wherever the work requires it.

“
“The quote was low, then it kept going up.”

You get a written scope of work that lists every material and fixture before we start. If we find hidden damage behind a wall, we show you and price it before doing any extra work.

“
“I can’t picture how it’ll look.”

Come to the showroom. Hold the tile, open vanity drawers, see quartz under real light.

“
“I just want someone who picks up the phone.”

Call 281-550-8900 during business hours and you’ll reach our office.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
What We Remodel
01
Full bathroom remodels.

Demo to walkthrough under one contract: plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, tile, vanity, countertops, lighting, ventilation and glass.

02
Shower remodels and walk-in showers.

Searching “shower remodel near me” or “walk-in shower companies near me”? We build custom walk-in showers with benches, niches, frameless glass and low or curbless entries.

03
Tub-to-shower conversions.

Replace a tub you never use with a shower that’s easier to step into.

04
Master bathroom remodels.

Bigger showers, double vanities, freestanding tubs and storage.

05
Bathrooms for seniors.

Our CAPS certified team designs curbless showers, installs walk-in tubs, and adds grab bars, seats and slip-resistant floors.

06
Affordable refreshes.

A new vanity top, faucets, lighting and paint can go a long way when a full remodel isn’t in the budget.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
How to Compare Bathroom Remodelers Near You

Get two or three quotes, and ask every company the same questions. The answers tell you more than the price does.

1.
Do you have a showroom I can visit?

A physical location means accountability.

2.
Is your crew in-house?

Or will the whole job be handed to a subcontractor you’ve never met?

3.
Who does the plumbing and electrical, and are they licensed in Texas?
4.
Who pulls permits?

The contractor should, not you.

5.
What waterproofing goes behind the shower tile?

You want a named system, like Schluter-KERDI, not “we use cement board.”

6.
Does the quote list every material?

Watch for large “allowances” that can grow later.

7.
How do you handle hidden damage?

It should be shown and priced before it’s fixed.

8.
What’s the warranty, and is there a deductible?
9.
Can I see local projects and real reviews?

Check Google and Houzz, not just the website.

Red flags to watch for
A large cash deposit before any design work
A price given over the phone without seeing the room
No written scope, or a one-line quote
Pressure to sign the same day
No physical address
YOUR DREAM REMODELING
What’s in Our Written Scope

So you know exactly what you’re comparing, every proposal we write includes:

Demolition and disposal
Floor and wall protection through your home
Plumbing and electrical work, with licensed trades where required
Waterproofing system named
Tile, vanity, countertop, fixture and glass selections listed by brand and model
Permits and inspections, where required
Final cleaning and walkthrough
Warranty terms

BATHROOM REMODELING HOUSTON, TX
Bathroom Remodeling in Houston, TX

A bathroom remodel should do more than replace outdated tile. It should make the room easier to use, easier to maintain and better suited to the way you live today. Your Dream Remodeling provides full-service bathroom remodeling in Houston, TX, including complete bathroom renovations, master bathrooms, walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, custom vanities, countertops, flooring and accessibility-focused upgrades. Start with a free in-home consultation, then explore cabinetry, fixtures, flooring and finishes at our Houston Showroom & Design Center at 1718 N Fry Rd, Suite 330, Houston, TX 77084.

Schedule a Free In-Home Consultation
or call 281-550-8900
YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling Designed Around How You Use the Space

Most homeowners are not remodeling simply because they want different tile. Usually, the shower feels cramped, the tub is rarely used, storage is limited, lighting is poor or the original layout wastes valuable floor space.

A successful bathroom renovation starts with layout, storage, shower size, accessibility and existing conditions before moving into materials and finishes.

For a broader look at the renovation options we provide, explore our remodeling services.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling Services in Houston
01
Complete Bathroom Remodels

A complete bathroom renovation may include demolition, shower or bathtub replacement, plumbing and electrical updates, waterproofing, tile, cabinetry, vanity countertops, flooring, lighting, shower glass and finishing work.

Planning the entire room as one project allows the layout, materials and construction details to work together instead of becoming disconnected upgrades.

02
Master Bathroom Remodeling

Primary bathrooms often provide the biggest opportunity to improve comfort and functionality.

Common upgrades include:

Larger walk-in showers
Freestanding tubs
Double vanities
Better drawer and linen storage
Frameless shower glass
New flooring
Improved lighting

A larger bathroom does not always need more fixtures. Removing an unused element can sometimes create better circulation, more storage or a more comfortable shower.

Planning a larger primary suite? Explore our Master Bathroom Remodel Guide for more detail on layouts, materials and design decisions.

03
Walk-In Shower Remodeling

A properly planned walk-in shower can improve both accessibility and everyday use.

Options may include built-in niches, bench seating, handheld shower fixtures, frameless glass, low-threshold or curbless entry, updated drainage and waterproofing.

For shower styles, conversions and planning considerations, visit our Walk-In Shower Guide.

04
Tub-to-Shower Conversions

If a bathtub is rarely used, converting its footprint into a shower can provide a wider entrance, more usable shower space and easier everyday access.

Before removing a tub, consider the home’s other bathrooms, who uses the space and your long-term plans. The right decision should be based on how the room is actually used.

05
Guest, Small Bathroom and Powder Room Remodeling

Compact bathrooms benefit from careful planning. Better-scaled vanities, improved lighting, practical storage, easy-care surfaces and a more efficient shower or tub layout can make limited square footage work harder.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Bathroom Cabinets, Tile and Countertops

Bathroom materials should be selected for durability, maintenance and design compatibility.

Cabinetry may include stock, semi-custom or custom vanities, with storage options such as drawer stacks, linen towers and medicine cabinets.

Porcelain tile is a practical option for floors and shower walls because of its low water absorption and broad range of finishes.

Natural stone can create a distinctive appearance but generally requires more maintenance.

Quartz countertops provide a nonporous, low-maintenance vanity surface with many colors and patterns available.

Shower glass may be frameless, framed or sliding depending on the layout, door clearance and budget.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Layout Changes, Lighting and Ventilation

Keeping major fixtures close to existing plumbing locations can help control remodeling costs. However, changing the layout can be worthwhile when the existing footprint is the main problem.

That may include enlarging a shower, removing a garden tub, moving a vanity, improving door clearance or opening a partition.

Lighting and ventilation should also be considered early. Vanity lighting, ceiling lighting, wet-location fixtures and appropriate ventilation all affect how the finished bathroom performs.

Where required, plumbing, electrical and mechanical work is handled through appropriately licensed Texas specialty contractors.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Accessibility and Aging-in-Place Remodeling

Accessibility-focused bathroom design can improve safety without making the room feel institutional.

Options may include:

Curbless or low-threshold showers
Wider shower entrances
Shower benches
Handheld shower heads
Grab bars
Slip-resistant flooring
Comfort-height toilets
Walk-in tubs

Curbless showers require careful planning of floor slope, drainage and waterproofing.

Homeowners considering accessible bathing can also explore our Houston Walk-In Tub Guide.

These are planning ranges, not fixed quotes. Final pricing depends on scope, materials, existing conditions and whether plumbing or layout changes are required.

For a deeper pricing breakdown, read our Bathroom Remodel Cost in Houston Guide.

What Affects Bathroom Remodeling Cost?

The main variables include:

Plumbing relocation
Shower size and complexity
Tile selection and installation
Cabinetry and countertops
Custom shower glass
Electrical or structural changes
Existing conditions discovered during demolition

A clear proposal should explain what is included and how unforeseen work or change orders are handled.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
How Long Does a Bathroom Remodel Take?

Project duration depends on scope, material lead times and existing conditions.

A small same-footprint guest bathroom should not follow the same schedule as a master bathroom involving plumbing relocation, custom cabinetry, countertops and a new shower.

Bathroom remodeling typically moves through preparation, demolition, wet-area work, cabinetry, countertops, flooring, wall finishes, shower glass and final completion.

For the full workflow, see our remodeling process.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling Permits in Houston

Permit requirements depend on the scope of work and the property’s jurisdiction.

Finish-only work may not require the same permits as projects involving plumbing, electrical or structural changes. Applicable trade work should be handled by appropriately licensed contractors.

Permit requirements should therefore be reviewed against the actual project rather than assuming every bathroom renovation follows the same rules.

How to Compare Bathroom Remodeling Contractors in Houston

Before hiring any remodeler, ask:

What exactly is included in the proposal?
Are material selections and allowances clearly identified?
Who manages the project?
How are permits and inspections handled?
Who performs licensed plumbing and electrical work?
How are unforeseen conditions handled?
What is the change-order process?
What workmanship warranty is provided?
Can you review completed projects and customer feedback?

The goal is not simply to find the lowest quote. It is to understand what you are buying, what is included and how the project will be managed.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Why Katy Bathrooms Wear Out the Way They Do

Katy grew fast. Whole neighborhoods went up in a few years, often with the same builder packages repeated street after street. That means Katy bathrooms tend to fail in predictable ways. Knowing them upfront helps you plan the right remodel, not just a prettier version of the same problem.

01
The oversized tub and the undersized shower

Builders in the late ‘90s and 2000s loved the garden tub. Homeowners today mostly don’t. Removing the tub and combining both spaces into one walk-in shower usually gives you a shower that’s two or three times bigger, with room for a bench, a niche and a real glass enclosure. Worried about losing the tub? As long as the house keeps one tub, usually in a hall or kids’ bath, most Katy buyers won’t miss it in the master.

02
Floor tile that keeps cracking

Katy homes sit on slab foundations over expansive clay. The clay swells after heavy rain and shrinks through long, dry summers, and the slab moves a little with it. Tile set straight onto concrete doesn’t forgive that movement. You’ll see it as hairline cracks running across several tiles or grout that keeps popping loose. We fix the cause. New floors go down over an uncoupling membrane like Schluter-DITRA, and we place movement joints where the tile industry standards call for them. As members of the National Tile Contractors Association, that’s how we’re trained to set tile on a slab that moves.

03
White crust on glass and chrome

West Houston water is hard. Minerals dry on your shower door, faucet and dark tile and leave a haze that comes back a day after you clean it. When we plan your shower, we’ll point you toward glass with a factory protective coating, finishes like brushed nickel or matte black that hide spots, and larger tiles with fewer grout lines to scrub. See the shower glass options we install in Katy.

04
Soft walls behind the old shower

Katy’s humidity is hard on bathrooms. Many builder showers were built with no real waterproofing layer behind the tile. When we pull those walls, we regularly find stained backer board and mold. Every shower we build sits on a bonded waterproofing system, usually Schluter-KERDI, and we size the exhaust fan to the room so moisture actually leaves.

05
Post-Harvey repairs that were rushed

In 2017, homes near the Barker Reservoir, including parts of Cinco Ranch, Kelliwood and Canyon Gate, took on water. Thousands of bathrooms were rebuilt at the same time, often with whatever materials and crews were available. If yours was one of them and something never felt right, it’s worth a second look.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling Services in Katy
01
Garden Tub to Walk-In Shower

We take out the tub and the old stall, move the drain on the slab, and build one open walk-in shower with a bench, niches and frameless glass.

02
Master Bathroom Remodels

New shower, double vanity with quartz tops, heated floors, better lighting, and sometimes a private water closet for the toilet. A full master bathroom remodel is where most Katy homeowners see the biggest daily difference.

03
Kids’ and Jack-and-Jill Bathrooms

Katy ISD families often have two or three kids sharing one bath. We add a second sink where there’s room, choose tile and grout colors that hide wear, and keep a tub-shower combo so it works for bath-time now and teenagers later.

04
Shower-Only Remodels

If your vanity and floor are fine, we can rebuild just the shower: waterproofing, tile, a new shower base or tiled pan, and glass.

05
Walk-In Tubs and Mobility Showers

Planning to stay in Katy long term, or moving a parent in? We build curbless mobility showers and install walk-in tubs. As a Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist team, we plan grab bar blocking, seat height and door clearance from the start.

06
Small Baths and Powder Rooms

Hall baths and powder rooms get used hard. We plan vanity depth, door swing and lighting so they feel bigger than they are.

YOUR DREAM REMODELING
What a Garden Tub Conversion Looks Like, Week by Week

This is our most common Katy project, so here’s how it usually goes once construction starts.

1
Week 1:

Floor and wall protection goes down through your house. We demo the tub, the old shower and the tile, then check the framing and slab for water damage.

2
Week 2:

Plumbing moves the drain and valve. We trench the slab if needed, pass any required inspection, and install backer board and waterproofing.

3
Week 3:

Tile goes on the shower walls, floor and bench. Grout and sealing follow.

4
Week 4:

Vanity, countertop and fixtures go in. Glass is measured after tile is done and installed when it arrives. Then we do a final walkthrough with you.

Larger master remodels usually take 5 to 8 weeks, mainly because of custom vanity and glass lead times.

Permits and HOA Rules in Katy

Katy crosses Harris, Fort Bend and Waller counties. Some addresses fall inside City of Katy limits. Many others are in unincorporated county areas served by a MUD. What you need depends on your address and the work: plumbing changes and new electrical circuits usually need permits and inspections, while a vanity swap usually doesn’t. We handle the paperwork. HOAs in Cinco Ranch, Cross Creek Ranch, Elyson and most master-planned communities don’t typically review interior work. They do have rules on dumpsters, portable toilets, contractor parking and working hours. We check yours before we schedule.
